expected_revision.description: The timeline revision this proposal was written against: the revision from your latest timeline_get. A stale revision fails rather than overwriting newer edits.

rebase_policy.description: strict (default) requires the exact revision; independent lets disjoint, independent proposal cards apply after other edits.

mode.description: workshop for ordinary editing proposals; production_finish only for final delivery polish the creator asked for.

decision.description: propose when options change the timeline; no_change when nothing should change; blocked when a required capability or input is missing (explain it in unresolved_gaps).

summary.description: The card's title: one line naming the visible or audible change, e.g. "The DREAMCUT word becomes its own clip you can edit". Describe what the viewer will see or hear, in everyday words, as the creator would say it. No build terms (baked, native text, transparent clip, element, alpha, composite, props), field names or ids; name clips by what they show. Quote on-screen words.

id.description: Shared by every step of one larger edit, e.g. "opener-ep1".

step.description: This step's place in the queue, from 1. Order steps the way a creator would settle them: placement and timing before sound, sound before polish.

title.description: A few plain words naming what this step changes, shown in the queue, e.g. "Place the opener" or "Sound effects".

needs_steps.description: Legacy: earlier steps this one builds on. A step must apply on its own whatever happens to the others, so new steps omit it (the default is none); steps that depend on each other belong in one card.

wave.description: Send a large edit as a queue of small steps the creator settles one after another. Each step is its own proposal_create call with the same wave id, and each must apply on its own in any order: approving, tuning or rejecting one never breaks another.

caps.description: Optional change budget; the server derives the counts from the operations.

max_mutations.description: Omit it; the server applies its runtime cap. A value you send must equal that cap.

requested_mutations.description: Omit it; the server counts the changed fields. A value you send must equal that count.

max_renders.description: Renders the proposal may request; 0 (default) for ordinary edits. Export happens only on an explicit creator request.

speaker_overlap_intended.description: Set true only when the creator asked for a graphic in this option to cover the speaker's face. Without it, an option whose text or drawing lands on the face is refused.

coordinate_fallback_reason.description: Why text or shapes in this option are placed by coordinates (absX/absY, media_offset_x/y) instead of place: the relation the place vocabulary cannot express, the creator's request for exact values, or the measuring tool the values came from (svg_pieces_compile returns one). Without it, coordinate placement on text and shapes is refused.

index.description: Position of the dropped dial in review_controls.

dropped_review_controls.description: Set by the server when it drops an invalid review dial; do not send it.

review_controls.description: Usually omit it: the server makes every supported field this option changes a main dial. Send it only to choose different main dials or link equal values across clips: each {operation_index, target, field, linked_operation_indices?, section?} exposes one field this option proposes. For a sequence of beats (stops, hops, sections), give every dial of one beat the same section, named by what the viewer sees there (for example To the pole), and list the beats in time order: the card shows one heading per section in that order. Send [] when no field needs a main dial (for example a motion graphic whose own controls are the dials); every supported field stays in Advanced adjustments. A sound's volume is always a main dial, shown first. An invalid dial is dropped with a reason and the edit still stages.

motion_main_controls.description: Your choice of a placed motion graphic's main dials: the ids of its controls the creator most likely wants for this change, judged each time (see the dreamcut-proposals skill). The rest sit in Advanced adjustments. [] puts them all in Advanced. Omitted: the card leads with the settings that differ from the render the graphic replaces, or every dial for a new graphic. Ids a graphic does not declare are ignored.

review_controls_origin.description: Set by the server: who chose the main dials; do not send it.

operation_index.description: Operation whose field has no dial.

field.description: The changed field the creator cannot tune.

value_kind.description: Shape of the value, to tell toggles, lists and animation apart.

control_gaps.description: Set by the server: changed fields the creator cannot tune from the review card; do not send it.

label.description: Short name for this option, e.g. "Snappier" or "Slide in from the left". Describe what the viewer will see or hear, in everyday words, as the creator would say it. No build terms (baked, native text, transparent clip, element, alpha, composite, props), field names or ids; name clips by what they show. Quote on-screen words.

summary.description: What this option changes on screen or in the sound. Describe what the viewer will see or hear, in everyday words, as the creator would say it. No build terms (baked, native text, transparent clip, element, alpha, composite, props), field names or ids; name clips by what they show. Quote on-screen words.

requested_mutations.description: Omit it; the server counts the fields this option changes. A value you send must equal that count.

type.description: Optional and ignored: the keys you set (patch, props, create_*, remove_*) decide what the operation does.

follows_visual.description: Link this sound to a picture clip so it starts at the anchor plus offset and moves with it (timeline_start is then derived). Use for a motion graphic's sound effects in a first proposal; unlink later with clear_props: ["follows_visual"] to edit or swap sounds one by one.

element_id.description: The picture clip this sound moves with: an existing element id, or the element_id of a create_visual earlier in the same option.

offset_seconds.description: Seconds from the anchor (the cue, or the picture's start when no cue) to this sound's start, on the timeline clock. Usually 0 with a cue.

cue.description: A named moment of a linked motion graphic (its controls file timing.cues, e.g. "impact"). The sound then follows that moment when timing knobs change. Omit to anchor to the clip start.

grade_exposure_ev.description: Exposure (editor Properties). Range -3 to 3; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_exposure_ev.

grade_contrast.description: Contrast (editor Properties). Range 0 to 2; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_contrast.

grade_contrast_pivot.description: Contrast pivot (editor Properties). The tone contrast turns around, on the grade axis: 0.48 is mid grey; lower keeps shadows, higher keeps highlights. Range 0.2 to 0.8; 0.4797 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_contrast_pivot.

grade_highlights.description: Highlights (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_highlights.

grade_shadows.description: Shadows (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_shadows.

grade_whites.description: Whites (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_whites.

grade_blacks.description: Blacks (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_blacks.

grade_saturation.description: Saturation (editor Properties). Range 0 to 2; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_saturation.

grade_temperature.description: Temperature (editor Properties). White balance: negative is cooler (blue), positive is warmer (amber). Shown in the editor ×100. Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_temperature.

grade_tint.description: Tint (editor Properties). Green–magenta balance; 0 leaves it unchanged. Shown in the editor ×100. Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_tint.

grade_hue_degrees.description: Hue (editor Properties). Range -180 to 180; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_hue_degrees.

grade_wheel_lift.description: Shadows color (editor Properties). Lift: moves the dark end of the picture; whites stay put. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_lift.

grade_wheel_gamma.description: Midtones color (editor Properties). Gamma: bends the middle of the range; black and white stay put. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_gamma.

grade_wheel_gain.description: Highlights color (editor Properties). Gain: scales the bright end; the master is in stops. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_gain.

grade_wheel_offset.description: Overall color (editor Properties). Offset: shifts every tone equally, the usual way to correct a colour cast. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_offset.

grade_slice_red.description: Color slice: Reds (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_red.

grade_slice_yellow.description: Color slice: Yellows (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. grade_slice_green.description: Color slice: Greens (editor Properties). grade_slice_cyan.description: Color slice: Cyans (editor Properties). grade_slice_blue.description: Color slice: Blues (editor Properties). grade_slice_magenta.description: Color slice: Magentas (editor Properties). grade_slice_skin.description: Color slice: Skin tones (editor Properties). grade_curve_y.description: Brightness curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on all channels: x and y on the grade axis, 0.48 is mid grey and 0.68 is SDR white; [0,0,1,1] is unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_y.

grade_curve_r.description: Red curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on red only, same axis as the brightness curve. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_r.

grade_curve_g.description: Green curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on green only, same axis as the brightness curve. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_g.

grade_curve_b.description: Blue curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on blue only, same axis as the brightness curve. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_b.

grade_curve_hue_hue.description: Hue vs hue curve (editor Properties). x is hue (0 red, 0.17 yellow, 0.33 green, 0.5 cyan, 0.67 blue, 0.83 magenta, wraps); y is the hue shift in degrees, 0 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_hue_hue.

grade_curve_hue_sat.description: Hue vs saturation curve (editor Properties). x is hue (wraps); y multiplies saturation for that hue, 1 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_hue_sat.

grade_curve_hue_lum.description: Hue vs brightness curve (editor Properties). x is hue (wraps); y is a brightness change in stops for that hue, 0 unchanged; neutral greys never move. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_hue_lum.

grade_curve_lum_sat.description: Brightness vs saturation curve (editor Properties). x is brightness on the grade axis; y multiplies saturation there, 1 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_lum_sat.

grade_curve_sat_sat.description: Saturation vs saturation curve (editor Properties). x is the input saturation (0 grey to 1 vivid); y multiplies it, 1 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_sat_sat.

subject_window_parent_id.description: Subject window: the video clip (existing element id or an earlier create_visual in this option) whose moving cutout this clip shows through. Requires subject_window_mask.

source_url.description: Folder URL of the prepared grayscale mask frames, copied from cutout_status grid_matte_mask.

source_start_seconds.description: Subject footage second (source clock) of mask frame 0.

fps.description: Mask frames per second on the subject footage's source clock.

width.description: Mask frame width in pixels (same aspect as the subject footage).

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the subject footage the mask was prepared from.

subject_window_mask.description: Subject window: the subject footage's prepared cutout mask (cutout_status grid_matte_mask).

subject_window_mode.description: Show footage (editor Properties). inside shows this clip only within the subject's shape; outside shows it everywhere except the subject. One of inside, outside; inside is the default.

subject_window_feather.description: Edge softness (editor Properties). Width of the soft edge in pixels at 1080 width; 0 is a crisp outline. Range 0 to 100; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

subject_window_expand.description: Expand edge (editor Properties). Pixels at 1080 width: positive grows the window past the subject's outline, negative shrinks it inside. Range -80 to 80; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

subject_window_strength.description: Window strength (editor Properties). 1 hides the clip fully where the window is closed; lower values let it show through faintly; 0 turns the window off. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

ripple_after.description: For an inserted clip such as an opener: when a timing knob changes its render's length, every clip after it moves by the difference. Omit for overlays that should not push the edit.

directional_blur_x.description: Horizontal blur in pixels at 1080 width. With transition_keyframes.directional_blur_x it is that envelope's peak, so the card's Horizontal blur dial scales the whole envelope.

directional_blur_y.description: Vertical blur in pixels at 1080 width; with a directional_blur_y envelope it is that envelope's peak.

camera_id.description: The camera this clip is seen through: the element_id of a shape_kind camera (an existing one, or a create_shape earlier in this option). Its push-ins and pans move it as its outermost transform.

parentId.description: The footage clip on the timeline the surface is in.

referenceTime.description: Source second the corners were first placed on.

t.description: Source second of this sample on the footage's own clock.

quad.description: The surface's four corners at t, top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, as fractions of the source frame.

visible.description: Whether the surface is in view at t.

samples.description: Tracked corners over time, copied unchanged from surface_track_status.

visibleFrom.description: First source second the attachment shows.

visibleTo.description: Last source second the attachment shows.

surface_track.description: Place this picture on a tracked flat surface in other footage (a billboard, a TV, a phone): the four-corner track from surface_track_status. The picture's whole frame is drawn onto the surface with perspective, follows the footage's source clock and any camera the footage follows. Do not also set camera_id.

surface_region.description: The part of the tracked surface this picture covers, [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the surface: inset from [0,0,1,1] to leave the screen's own edge showing, or split it to put several pictures side by side.

t.description: Clip-relative seconds; the first point is 0.

v.description: Crop edges [top, right, bottom, left] as fractions of the frame; [0,0,0,0] shows it all.

ease.description: Easing from this point to the next.

mask_inset_keyframes.description: Animate the crop edges over the clip: [{t, v: [top, right, bottom, left], ease}], t in clip-relative seconds from 0. Use for wipes and windows that open or widen.

mask_corner_radius.description: Crop roundness: corner radius of the visible crop (mask_inset) as a fraction of its shorter side, 0 to 0.5; 0.5 on a crop that is square in pixels is a circle (a corner bubble). Animate it with transition_keyframes.mask_corner_radius.

gradient_map_amount.description: Color map mix (editor Properties). Maps brightness onto the shadows/midtones/highlights colours (default: a red-orange-yellow thermal ramp). 0 is off, 1 is the full map; key it for a flash. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.gradient_map_amount.

gradient_map_contrast.description: Color map contrast (editor Properties). Stretches brightness before mapping: above 1 pushes more of the picture into the shadow and highlight colours. Range 0.25 to 3; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.gradient_map_contrast.

gradient_map_shadows.description: Color map shadows (editor Properties). Colour for the darkest parts. A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

gradient_map_midtones.description: Color map midtones (editor Properties). Colour for middle brightness. A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

gradient_map_highlights.description: Color map highlights (editor Properties). Colour for the brightest parts. A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

film_grain.description: Film grain (editor Properties). Moving film-grain texture, strongest in the midtones. 0 is off; 0.2–0.4 reads as fine film stock, above 0.6 is heavy. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_grain.

film_grain_size.description: Film grain size (editor Properties). Grain cell size in pixels at 1080 width; larger reads as faster, coarser stock. Range 0.5 to 6; 1.5 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_halation.description: Halation (editor Properties). Red-orange glow film shows around bright edges (lights, windows, sky against trees). 0 is off; key it to bloom on a light. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_halation.

film_halation_radius.description: Halation spread (editor Properties). How far the halation glow spreads, in pixels at 1080 width. Range 2 to 80; 16 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_bloom.description: Bloom (editor Properties). Soft neutral glow around the brightest parts, for a dreamy or diffused look. 0 is off. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_bloom.

film_bloom_radius.description: Bloom spread (editor Properties). How far the bloom spreads, in pixels at 1080 width. Range 4 to 160; 48 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_glow_threshold.description: Glow starts at (editor Properties). Brightness above which halation and bloom start (0–1 of white); lower lets more of the picture glow. Range 0.3 to 0.98; 0.72 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_vignette.description: Vignette (editor Properties). Darkens the frame's edges and corners. 0 is off, 1 is black corners. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_vignette.

film_vignette_size.description: Vignette size (editor Properties). Distance from the centre where darkening starts; 1 is the corners, lower closes in. Range 0.2 to 1.5; 0.8 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_vignette_softness.description: Vignette softness (editor Properties). Width of the fade from clear to dark; higher is gentler. Range 0.05 to 1.5; 0.6 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_split_tone.description: Split tone (editor Properties). Tints shadows and highlights toward two hues (teal shadows, warm highlights by default) without changing brightness. 0 is off. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_split_tone.

film_split_shadow_hue.description: Shadow tint (editor Properties). Hue in degrees the shadows lean toward: 0 red, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 240 blue, 300 magenta. Range 0 to 360; 195 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_split_highlight_hue.description: Highlight tint (editor Properties). Hue in degrees the highlights lean toward, as for the shadow tint. Range 0 to 360; 35 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_split_balance.description: Split balance (editor Properties). Moves the point between the shadow and highlight tints: positive gives highlights more of the picture. Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

glitch_amount.description: Glitch amount (editor Properties). Digital glitch strength: share of displaced/smeared bands, their sideways shift and the colour split. 0 is off; key it for a burst on a beat. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_amount.

glitch_block_size.description: Glitch block size (editor Properties). Band height in pixels at 1080 width. Range 8 to 240; 48 leaves the picture unchanged.

glitch_shift.description: Glitch shift (editor Properties). Largest sideways band displacement as a fraction of the frame width. Range 0 to 0.5; 0.12 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_shift.

glitch_rgb_split.description: Glitch color split (editor Properties). Red/blue channel offset in pixels at 1080 width. Range 0 to 60; 10 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_rgb_split.

glitch_smear.description: Glitch smear (editor Properties). Share of affected bands that smear (stretch one column or row) instead of shifting. Range 0 to 1; 0.35 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_smear.

glitch_rate.description: Glitch speed (editor Properties). How many times per second the pattern changes (on the clip's own clock). Range 1 to 30; 12 leaves the picture unchanged.

glitch_seed.description: Glitch pattern (editor Properties). Whole number choosing a different but repeatable pattern. Range 0 to 9999; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

camera_id.description: The camera this text is seen through: the element_id of a shape_kind camera (an existing one, or a create_shape earlier in this option). Its push-ins and pans move it as its outermost transform.

relative_to.description: The anchor: an element id, or the ids of a group (for example every piece of a drawing from svg_pieces_compile's label_slot). Each must already be on the timeline or created earlier in this option.

side.description: Where this sits against the anchor's box: below, above, left, right, or inside it.

gap.description: Space between this and the anchor as a share of the canvas height; 0.02 is a snug label gap. Inside, it is the inset from the anchor's edges.

align.description: Along the anchor's edge: start (left or top edges line up), center, or end (right or bottom edges line up). Inside, it is horizontal: start left, end right.

vertical_align.description: Inside only: start sits against the anchor's top edge, end against its bottom; omitted centres it. Inside + align start + vertical_align start is the top-left corner.

place.description: Place this relative to other elements instead of giving coordinates: code computes the position, keeps it there when the anchor moves or is tuned, and shows it through the anchor's camera. The default for text and drawn shapes; do not combine with absX/absY, media_offset_x/y or a position preset.

positionPreset.description: A named spot on the frame, when the text is not placed relative to something (place).

rotationDeg.description: Rotation (editor Properties). Turns the whole text block in degrees, clockwise; added to any entrance or exit spin. Range -180 to 180; 0 leaves it upright.

index.description: Word position in the text, 0 for the first word.

wordStyles.description: Word looks: colour a word, or put a highlight box behind it, for example the brand word of a title. Words are counted from 0.

title.description: The shape's name on the timeline, in plain words, for example "Ring".

timeline_start.description: Where the shape starts on the timeline, in seconds.

duration_seconds.description: How long the shape is on screen, in seconds.

lane_key.description: A visual lane. Overlapping visuals need separate lanes.

lane_index.description: Order among visual lanes; higher lanes draw on top.

shape_kind.description: A base shape: rect (boxes, bars, underlines), ellipse (circles, rings), polygon, star, line, arc, arrow; path for any other outline, given as shape_path_d or shape_contours; or camera, which draws nothing: keyframe its media_offset_x/y (where it looks), media_scale (zoom) and media_rotation for a push-in or pan, and point shapes at it with camera_id.

shape_width.description: Width as a fraction of the canvas height, so equal width and height make a circle or square.

shape_height.description: Height as a fraction of the canvas height.

shape_fill.description: Fill colour, or null for no fill (a ring or an outline box).

shape_stroke.description: Outline colour, or null for no outline.

shape_stroke_width.description: Outline width in pixels at 1080 canvas height.

shape_corner_radius.description: Rectangle corner rounding as a fraction of the shorter side; 0.5 makes a pill.

shape_star_depth.description: Star inner radius as a share of the outer one; lower is spikier.

shape_arc_start.description: Arc start in degrees clockwise from the top.

shape_arc_end.description: Arc end in degrees clockwise from the top; 360 more than the start is a full circle.

shape_arrow_head.description: Arrow head length as a share of the width.

shape_arrow_shaft.description: Arrow shaft thickness as a share of the height.

closed.description: true joins the last point back to the first.

x.description: Across the shape's box, -0.5 left edge to 0.5 right edge.

y.description: Down the shape's box, -0.5 top edge to 0.5 bottom edge.

in.description: Curve handle toward the previous point, as an offset from this point.

out.description: Curve handle toward the next point, as an offset from this point.

shape_contours.description: For path: freeform contours as points with optional curve handles; an inner contour cuts a hole. Prefer shape_path_d when you have SVG path data.

shape_draw.description: How much of the outline is drawn, 0 to 1, tracing each contour from its first point in order: the top for preset shapes, clockwise; the left end for a line. Keyframe it to draw the outline on.

shape_taper.description: Hand-drawn outline: how much each line thins to a point at its ends, 0 (even line) to 1. Any taper or wobble draws the outline as pen ink.

shape_wobble.description: Hand-drawn outline: how far each line drifts and swells, 0 (ruled) to 1 (loose sketch). About 0.3 reads as a confident pen.

shape_seed.description: Hand-drawn outline: a whole number picking a different but repeatable wobble. Give sibling pieces different seeds.

camera_id.description: The camera this shape is seen through: the element_id of a shape_kind camera (an existing one, or a create_shape earlier in this option). Its push-ins and pans then move this shape with every other follower; null detaches it.

relative_to.description: The anchor: an element id, or the ids of a group (for example every piece of a drawing from svg_pieces_compile's label_slot). Each must already be on the timeline or created earlier in this option.

side.description: Where this sits against the anchor's box: below, above, left, right, or inside it.

gap.description: Space between this and the anchor as a share of the canvas height; 0.02 is a snug label gap. Inside, it is the inset from the anchor's edges.

align.description: Along the anchor's edge: start (left or top edges line up), center, or end (right or bottom edges line up). Inside, it is horizontal: start left, end right.

vertical_align.description: Inside only: start sits against the anchor's top edge, end against its bottom; omitted centres it. Inside + align start + vertical_align start is the top-left corner.

place.description: Place this relative to other elements instead of giving coordinates: code computes the position, keeps it there when the anchor moves or is tuned, and shows it through the anchor's camera. The default for text and drawn shapes; do not combine with absX/absY, media_offset_x/y or a position preset.

shape_path_d.description: For path: SVG path data (the d of a <path>, any commands). It is fitted into the shape's width and height and stored as editable points; draw it at its own aspect ratio to keep its proportions.

animationIn.description: fade: the shape fades in over animationInDuration seconds from its start.

animationOut.description: fade: the shape fades out over animationOutDuration seconds before its end.

media_scale.description: Size multiplier around the shape's centre; 1 is its own width and height. Up to 3, or up to 10 for a camera's zoom.

media_offset_x.description: Horizontal centre in half-canvas units: 0 centred, 1 the right edge.

media_offset_y.description: Vertical centre in half-canvas units: 0 centred, 1 the bottom edge.

t.description: Clip-relative seconds; the first key is at 0 and times increase.

v.description: Value at t (scale).

ease.description: How the value travels to the next key.

shape_contours.description: Morph a path shape: outlines over time. Outlines may differ in points and contours; they are matched automatically (points added along edges, a missing contour grows from a point). For the cleanest morph give partner outlines the same number of points, starting at matching places.

keyframes.description: Animate inside the clip: for a shockwave keyframe media_scale up and media_opacity down; for a ring drawing in keyframe shape_draw from 0 to 1; to morph a path shape keyframe shape_contours.

create_shape.description: Add a rectangle or ellipse on a visual lane: boxes, bars, underlines, rings, circles and shockwaves. Every shape is its own editable element.

frame_rate.description: Project frames per second for preview, editing and export (24, 25, 30, 50 or 60). Changing it re-snaps every picture clip to the new frame grid; captions and audio keep their exact times.

factor.description: How much faster everything plays from this clip on: 1.15 is 15% faster, 0.9 slower. The card's Speed dial.

ripple_lane_keys.description: Lanes that speed up together, including this clip's lane: usually the speaker and every picture, label and sound above it. Captions that follow the voice need not be listed.

max_affected_elements.description: Most clips this may move; the change is refused above it.

speed_change.description: Speed up or slow down this speaker clip and every later clip on the named lanes together, keeping animation and voice-bound captions in step.

use_recast.description: Replace the people in a placed video clip with a recast of the same moment (Generate's recast models, kept in the Library). The clip keeps its timeline timing; its in-point moves onto the recast's clock

recast_source_url.description: The kept recast clip in this project's media, e.g. /api/projects/<id>/media/generated/take.mp4

source_window_start.description: Where the recast starts on the clip's original footage clock, in seconds (the window sent to the model); for a clip already recast, still the original footage's clock

generation_id.description: The Generate request that produced the recast

model.description: The recast model's name, e.g. H3 Max Recast

spoken.description: Aligned spoken words as they appear in caption_source_text, e.g. "eighty k".

display.description: How those words read on screen, e.g. "$80K".

caption_display_substitutions.description: Spoken-to-written swaps for this cue; text must equal the spoken words with these applied. Timing still comes from the spoken words.

offsetX.description: X dial: move every caption left (negative) or right as a share of the frame width; send 0 so the creator gets the dial.

offsetY.description: Y dial: move every caption up (negative) or down as a share of the frame height; keep text off the speaker's face.

timing_mode.description: phrase shows the whole cue, active_word highlights the spoken word, single_word shows one word at a time and is saved as one caption per word.

singleWordFlipSeconds.description: Word flip dial for single_word: seconds each word flips in and out; 0 is a plain cut. Send it (0 unless the creator asked for motion) so the creator gets the dial.

hide_punctuation.description: Draw every caption without punctuation (commas, full stops, quotes); cue text stays the aligned words. Defaults to true; send false only when the creator explicitly asks for punctuation. The creator can switch it in Captions → Punctuation.

font_sizing.description: fixed keeps every caption at font_size_px and never shrinks it (keep cues short enough to fit on one line); fit shrinks a long caption to fit its line. Omitted is fit.

timeline_start.description: Where the clip starts on the timeline, in seconds.

duration.description: How long the clip lasts on the timeline, in seconds.

trim_start.description: Seconds removed from the start of the source media (source clock). Use to shorten from the front.

trim_end.description: Seconds removed from the end of the source media (source clock). Use to shorten from the back.

lane_key.description: Timeline lane the clip sits on, for example visual_1 or audio_1; must match the clip type.

lane_index.description: Order of the lane among lanes of its kind; higher visual lanes draw on top.

volume.description: Clip loudness as a linear gain: 1 = unchanged, 0 = silent, up to 4. For changes over time use props.volume_envelope.

fade_in.description: Seconds of fade from silence or black at the clip start.

fade_out.description: Seconds of fade to silence or black at the clip end.

playback_rate.description: Constant speed multiplier, above 0 and at most 4 (0.5 = half speed). Changing it rescales the clip's duration. To play backward, keep this positive and set props.playback_reverse to true.

title.description: The clip's name on the timeline, in plain words.

playback_reverse.description: Reverse a video clip: true plays its used source from the end back to the start (picture and sound) at its constant speed; false plays forward. Not combinable with speed steps or ramps.

playback_speed_steps.description: Constant-speed sections on the source clock: each {source_t, v} plays at v× (0.25–4) from source second source_t until the next step; source_t must increase and lie inside the used source window. grid_matte_cell_size.description: Cell size (editor Properties). Range 0 to 360; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

grid_matte_coverage.description: Mask coverage (editor Properties). Range 0 to 4; 1 leaves the picture unchanged.

grid_matte_line_opacity.description: Grid strength (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

grid_matte_line_width.description: Grid width (editor Properties). Range 0 to 8; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

subject_window_parent_id.description: Subject window: the video clip whose moving cutout this clip shows through. The window follows that clip's own timing and placement. Set with subject_window_mask; null removes the window.

source_url.description: Folder URL of the prepared grayscale mask frames, copied from cutout_status grid_matte_mask.

source_start_seconds.description: Subject footage second (source clock) of mask frame 0.

fps.description: Mask frames per second on the subject footage's source clock.

width.description: Mask frame width in pixels (same aspect as the subject footage).

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the subject footage the mask was prepared from.

subject_window_mask.description: Subject window: the prepared cutout mask of the subject clip's footage (cutout_status grid_matte_mask). It must cover every source second the subject clip shows.

subject_window_enabled.description: Subject window on (true) or switched off (false) without losing its subject and settings.

sticker_outline_width.description: Paper outline (editor Properties). Range 0 to 32; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.sticker_outline_width.

semanticLayout.description: Named placement on the safe grid: a slot (for example lower_right) and a size class; code derives position and scale. Prefer this over media_offset_x/y or absX/absY unless exact placement is requested.

volume_envelope.description: Volume automation within the clip: points {time_seconds, volume} in clip-relative seconds starting at 0 with strictly increasing times; volume is a linear gain (1 = unchanged, 0 = silent, up to 4). Use for fades and ducking inside one clip.

t.description: Clip-relative seconds; the first point is 0.

v.description: Crop edges [top, right, bottom, left] as fractions of the frame; [0,0,0,0] shows it all.

ease.description: Easing from this point to the next.

rotationDeg.description: Rotation (editor Properties). Turns the whole text block in degrees, clockwise; added to any entrance or exit spin. Range -180 to 180; 0 leaves it upright.

index.description: Word position in the text, 0 for the first word.

wordStyles.description: Word looks: colour a word, or put a highlight box behind it, for example the brand word of a title. Words are counted from 0.

timingMode.description: Caption reveal: phrase shows the whole cue, active_word highlights the word being spoken, single_word shows one word at a time. Word modes need word timings. A caption always holds exactly the words it shows: a multi-word single_word caption is saved as one caption per word.

hidePunctuation.description: Speech captions: draw the words without punctuation (commas, full stops, quotes). Captions made from speech hide it by default; set false only when the creator explicitly asks for punctuation. The caption text stays the aligned words; the creator switches it in Captions → Punctuation.

caption_follow_audio.description: When true, the caption stays bound to its linked speech clip and retimes with that clip's trims and speed changes.

subject_window_mode.description: Show footage (editor Properties). inside shows this clip only within the subject's shape; outside shows it everywhere except the subject. One of inside, outside; inside is the default.

subject_window_feather.description: Edge softness (editor Properties). Width of the soft edge in pixels at 1080 width; 0 is a crisp outline. Range 0 to 100; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

subject_window_expand.description: Expand edge (editor Properties). Pixels at 1080 width: positive grows the window past the subject's outline, negative shrinks it inside. Range -80 to 80; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

subject_window_strength.description: Window strength (editor Properties). 1 hides the clip fully where the window is closed; lower values let it show through faintly; 0 turns the window off. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

media_orientation.description: Orientation (editor Properties). Rotate the picture 90° clockwise or counterclockwise; original leaves it unrotated. One of original, clockwise, counterclockwise; original is the default.

media_mirror.description: Mirror (editor Properties). horizontal flips the picture left-to-right; none leaves it unchanged. One of none, horizontal; none is the default.

window_side_margin_percent.description: Window side margins (editor Properties). Range 0 to 45; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

window_vertical_margin_percent.description: Window top / bottom space (editor Properties). Range 0 to 45; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

window_center_y_percent.description: Window vertical center (editor Properties). Range 0 to 100; 50 leaves the picture unchanged.

window_corner_radius.description: Window roundness (editor Properties). Range 0 to 200; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

window_open_duration.description: Window opening (editor Properties). Range 0 to 10; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

media_blend_mode.description: Blend (editor Properties). One of normal, difference, exclusion; normal is the default.

iris_radius.description: Oval reveal (editor Properties). Oval reveal size: 2 = fully open (no mask), 0 = closed. Animate it for an iris wipe. Range 0 to 2; 2 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.iris_radius.

transition_blur.description: Transition blur (editor Properties). Range 0 to 40; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.transition_blur.

subject_flash.description: White flash (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.subject_flash.

subject_glow.description: Glow strength (editor Properties). Range 0 to 3; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.subject_glow.

subject_glow_radius.description: Glow radius (editor Properties). Range 0 to 80; 10 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.subject_glow_radius.

directional_blur_y.description: Vertical blur (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1080; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.directional_blur_y.

directional_blur_x.description: Horizontal blur (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1080; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.directional_blur_x.

zoom_blur.description: Edge blur (editor Properties). Range 0 to 40; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.zoom_blur.

iris_feather.description: Oval feather (editor Properties). Range 0 to 0.8; 0.08 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.iris_feather.

paper_fill_color.description: Recolor color (legacy) (editor Properties). A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

recolor_color.description: Recolor color (editor Properties). A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

recolor_amount.description: Recolor amount (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

recolor_preserve_shading.description: Preserve shading (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1; 1 leaves the picture unchanged.

media_scale.description: Scale (editor Properties). Picture size relative to its fitted size: 1 = fitted, 2 = twice as large. For a punch-in or zoom, animate it. Range 0.1 to 3; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.media_scale.

media_offset_x.description: Horizontal position (editor Properties). Horizontal position of the picture centre in half-canvas units: 0 = centred, positive moves right, 1 puts the centre on the right edge. Prefer semanticLayout unless exact placement is requested. Range -2 to 2; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.media_offset_x.

media_offset_y.description: Vertical position (editor Properties). Vertical position of the picture centre in half-canvas units: 0 = centred, positive moves down, 1 puts the centre on the bottom edge. Prefer semanticLayout unless exact placement is requested. Range -2 to 2; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.media_offset_y.

media_opacity.description: Opacity (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.media_opacity.

mask_inset.description: Mask edges (editor Properties). Crop: [top, right, bottom, left] insets as fractions of the frame; [0,0,0,0] shows the full frame. Soften the edge with mask_feather. Each value 0 to 0.95; [0,0,0,0] leaves it unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.mask_inset.

mask_feather.description: Mask feather (editor Properties). Range 0 to 0.5; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.mask_feather.

mask_corner_radius.description: Crop roundness (editor Properties). Rounds the corners of the visible crop (mask_inset) as a fraction of its shorter side: 0.5 makes a pill, and a circle when the crop is square in pixels. It follows the crop window, so place the bubble with mask_inset and move the picture into it with media_offset_x/y and media_scale. Combines with mask_feather for a soft edge. Range 0 to 0.5; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.mask_corner_radius.

grade_exposure_ev.description: Exposure (editor Properties). Range -3 to 3; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_exposure_ev.

grade_contrast.description: Contrast (editor Properties). Range 0 to 2; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_contrast.

grade_contrast_pivot.description: Contrast pivot (editor Properties). The tone contrast turns around, on the grade axis: 0.48 is mid grey; lower keeps shadows, higher keeps highlights. Range 0.2 to 0.8; 0.4797 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_contrast_pivot.

grade_highlights.description: Highlights (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_highlights.

grade_shadows.description: Shadows (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_shadows.

grade_whites.description: Whites (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_whites.

grade_blacks.description: Blacks (editor Properties). Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_blacks.

grade_saturation.description: Saturation (editor Properties). Range 0 to 2; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_saturation.

grade_temperature.description: Temperature (editor Properties). White balance: negative is cooler (blue), positive is warmer (amber). Shown in the editor ×100. Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_temperature.

grade_tint.description: Tint (editor Properties). Green–magenta balance; 0 leaves it unchanged. Shown in the editor ×100. Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_tint.

grade_hue_degrees.description: Hue (editor Properties). Range -180 to 180; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_hue_degrees.

chroma_key_color.description: Key colour (editor Properties). Green/blue-screen removal: the backdrop colour to make transparent. A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

chroma_key_tolerance.description: Key tolerance (editor Properties). Green/blue-screen removal: how far from chroma_key_color a pixel can be and still become transparent. Raise it if the backdrop remains; lower it if the subject erodes. Range 0 to 1; 0.18 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.chroma_key_tolerance.

chroma_key_softness.description: Key softness (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1; 0.08 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.chroma_key_softness.

chroma_key_spill.description: Key spill suppression (editor Properties). Range 0 to 1; 0.25 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.chroma_key_spill.

gradient_map_amount.description: Color map mix (editor Properties). Maps brightness onto the shadows/midtones/highlights colours (default: a red-orange-yellow thermal ramp). 0 is off, 1 is the full map; key it for a flash. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.gradient_map_amount.

gradient_map_contrast.description: Color map contrast (editor Properties). Stretches brightness before mapping: above 1 pushes more of the picture into the shadow and highlight colours. Range 0.25 to 3; 1 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.gradient_map_contrast.

gradient_map_shadows.description: Color map shadows (editor Properties). Colour for the darkest parts. A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

gradient_map_midtones.description: Color map midtones (editor Properties). Colour for middle brightness. A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

gradient_map_highlights.description: Color map highlights (editor Properties). Colour for the brightest parts. A #RRGGBB hex colour, for example #00FF00.

film_grain.description: Film grain (editor Properties). Moving film-grain texture, strongest in the midtones. 0 is off; 0.2–0.4 reads as fine film stock, above 0.6 is heavy. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_grain.

film_grain_size.description: Film grain size (editor Properties). Grain cell size in pixels at 1080 width; larger reads as faster, coarser stock. Range 0.5 to 6; 1.5 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_halation.description: Halation (editor Properties). Red-orange glow film shows around bright edges (lights, windows, sky against trees). 0 is off; key it to bloom on a light. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_halation.

film_halation_radius.description: Halation spread (editor Properties). How far the halation glow spreads, in pixels at 1080 width. Range 2 to 80; 16 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_bloom.description: Bloom (editor Properties). Soft neutral glow around the brightest parts, for a dreamy or diffused look. 0 is off. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_bloom.

film_bloom_radius.description: Bloom spread (editor Properties). How far the bloom spreads, in pixels at 1080 width. Range 4 to 160; 48 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_glow_threshold.description: Glow starts at (editor Properties). Brightness above which halation and bloom start (0–1 of white); lower lets more of the picture glow. Range 0.3 to 0.98; 0.72 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_vignette.description: Vignette (editor Properties). Darkens the frame's edges and corners. 0 is off, 1 is black corners. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_vignette.

film_vignette_size.description: Vignette size (editor Properties). Distance from the centre where darkening starts; 1 is the corners, lower closes in. Range 0.2 to 1.5; 0.8 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_vignette_softness.description: Vignette softness (editor Properties). Width of the fade from clear to dark; higher is gentler. Range 0.05 to 1.5; 0.6 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_split_tone.description: Split tone (editor Properties). Tints shadows and highlights toward two hues (teal shadows, warm highlights by default) without changing brightness. 0 is off. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.film_split_tone.

film_split_shadow_hue.description: Shadow tint (editor Properties). Hue in degrees the shadows lean toward: 0 red, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 240 blue, 300 magenta. Range 0 to 360; 195 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_split_highlight_hue.description: Highlight tint (editor Properties). Hue in degrees the highlights lean toward, as for the shadow tint. Range 0 to 360; 35 leaves the picture unchanged.

film_split_balance.description: Split balance (editor Properties). Moves the point between the shadow and highlight tints: positive gives highlights more of the picture. Range -1 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

glitch_amount.description: Glitch amount (editor Properties). Digital glitch strength: share of displaced/smeared bands, their sideways shift and the colour split. 0 is off; key it for a burst on a beat. Range 0 to 1; 0 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_amount.

glitch_block_size.description: Glitch block size (editor Properties). Band height in pixels at 1080 width. Range 8 to 240; 48 leaves the picture unchanged.

glitch_shift.description: Glitch shift (editor Properties). Largest sideways band displacement as a fraction of the frame width. Range 0 to 0.5; 0.12 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_shift.

glitch_rgb_split.description: Glitch color split (editor Properties). Red/blue channel offset in pixels at 1080 width. Range 0 to 60; 10 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_rgb_split.

glitch_smear.description: Glitch smear (editor Properties). Share of affected bands that smear (stretch one column or row) instead of shifting. Range 0 to 1; 0.35 leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.glitch_smear.

glitch_rate.description: Glitch speed (editor Properties). How many times per second the pattern changes (on the clip's own clock). Range 1 to 30; 12 leaves the picture unchanged.

glitch_seed.description: Glitch pattern (editor Properties). Whole number choosing a different but repeatable pattern. Range 0 to 9999; 0 leaves the picture unchanged.

grade_wheel_lift.description: Shadows color (editor Properties). Lift: moves the dark end of the picture; whites stay put. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_lift.

grade_wheel_gamma.description: Midtones color (editor Properties). Gamma: bends the middle of the range; black and white stay put. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_gamma.

grade_wheel_gain.description: Highlights color (editor Properties). Gain: scales the bright end; the master is in stops. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_gain.

grade_wheel_offset.description: Overall color (editor Properties). Offset: shifts every tone equally, the usual way to correct a colour cast. [red, green, blue, master]: red/green/blue push the colour toward that channel (balance them to tint without changing brightness); master moves all three. [0,0,0,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_wheel_offset.

grade_slice_red.description: Color slice: Reds (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_red.

grade_slice_yellow.description: Color slice: Yellows (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_yellow.

grade_slice_green.description: Color slice: Greens (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_green.

grade_slice_cyan.description: Color slice: Cyans (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_cyan.

grade_slice_blue.description: Color slice: Blues (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_blue.

grade_slice_magenta.description: Color slice: Magentas (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_magenta.

grade_slice_skin.description: Color slice: Skin tones (editor Properties). [hue shift in degrees, saturation multiplier, density]: only colours near this hue change; density darkens (positive) or lightens (negative) them. [0,1,0] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_slice_skin.

grade_curve_y.description: Brightness curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on all channels: x and y on the grade axis, 0.48 is mid grey and 0.68 is SDR white; [0,0,1,1] is unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_y.

grade_curve_r.description: Red curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on red only, same axis as the brightness curve. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_r.

grade_curve_g.description: Green curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on green only, same axis as the brightness curve. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_g.

grade_curve_b.description: Blue curve (editor Properties). Tone curve on blue only, same axis as the brightness curve. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_b.

grade_curve_hue_hue.description: Hue vs hue curve (editor Properties). x is hue (0 red, 0.17 yellow, 0.33 green, 0.5 cyan, 0.67 blue, 0.83 magenta, wraps); y is the hue shift in degrees, 0 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_hue_hue.

grade_curve_hue_sat.description: Hue vs saturation curve (editor Properties). x is hue (wraps); y multiplies saturation for that hue, 1 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_hue_sat.

grade_curve_hue_lum.description: Hue vs brightness curve (editor Properties). x is hue (wraps); y is a brightness change in stops for that hue, 0 unchanged; neutral greys never move. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_hue_lum.

grade_curve_lum_sat.description: Brightness vs saturation curve (editor Properties). x is brightness on the grade axis; y multiplies saturation there, 1 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_lum_sat.

grade_curve_sat_sat.description: Saturation vs saturation curve (editor Properties). x is the input saturation (0 grey to 1 vivid); y multiplies it, 1 unchanged. Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …], x from 0 to 1, at most 16 points; empty is no curve. Points between others bend only that part of the range. [] leaves the picture unchanged. Animate it with transition_keyframes.grade_curve_sat_sat.

shape_fill.description: Fill colour, or null for no fill (a ring or an outline box).

shape_stroke.description: Outline colour, or null for no outline.

shape_stroke_width.description: Outline width in pixels at 1080 canvas height.

shape_corner_radius.description: Rectangle corner rounding as a fraction of the shorter side; 0.5 makes a pill.

shape_star_depth.description: Star inner radius as a share of the outer one; lower is spikier.

shape_arc_start.description: Arc start in degrees clockwise from the top.

shape_arc_end.description: Arc end in degrees clockwise from the top; 360 more than the start is a full circle.

shape_arrow_head.description: Arrow head length as a share of the width.

shape_arrow_shaft.description: Arrow shaft thickness as a share of the height.

closed.description: true joins the last point back to the first.

x.description: Across the shape's box, -0.5 left edge to 0.5 right edge.

y.description: Down the shape's box, -0.5 top edge to 0.5 bottom edge.

in.description: Curve handle toward the previous point, as an offset from this point.

out.description: Curve handle toward the next point, as an offset from this point.

shape_contours.description: For path: freeform contours as points with optional curve handles; an inner contour cuts a hole. Prefer shape_path_d when you have SVG path data.

shape_draw.description: How much of the outline is drawn, 0 to 1, tracing each contour from its first point in order: the top for preset shapes, clockwise; the left end for a line. Keyframe it to draw the outline on.

shape_taper.description: Hand-drawn outline: how much each line thins to a point at its ends, 0 (even line) to 1. Any taper or wobble draws the outline as pen ink.

shape_wobble.description: Hand-drawn outline: how far each line drifts and swells, 0 (ruled) to 1 (loose sketch). About 0.3 reads as a confident pen.

shape_seed.description: Hand-drawn outline: a whole number picking a different but repeatable wobble. Give sibling pieces different seeds.

camera_id.description: The camera this shape is seen through: the element_id of a shape_kind camera (an existing one, or a create_shape earlier in this option). Its push-ins and pans then move this shape with every other follower; null detaches it.

relative_to.description: The anchor: an element id, or the ids of a group (for example every piece of a drawing from svg_pieces_compile's label_slot). Each must already be on the timeline or created earlier in this option.

side.description: Where this sits against the anchor's box: below, above, left, right, or inside it.

gap.description: Space between this and the anchor as a share of the canvas height; 0.02 is a snug label gap. Inside, it is the inset from the anchor's edges.

align.description: Along the anchor's edge: start (left or top edges line up), center, or end (right or bottom edges line up). Inside, it is horizontal: start left, end right.

vertical_align.description: Inside only: start sits against the anchor's top edge, end against its bottom; omitted centres it. Inside + align start + vertical_align start is the top-left corner.

place.description: Place this relative to other elements instead of giving coordinates: code computes the position, keeps it there when the anchor moves or is tuned, and shows it through the anchor's camera. The default for text and drawn shapes; do not combine with absX/absY, media_offset_x/y or a position preset.

shape_kind.description: Change a shape's base shape; path keeps its own shape_contours.

t.description: Clip-relative seconds; times increase.

v.description: The outline at t as SVG path data; every key is drawn in the same coordinates, and they are fitted into the shape's box together.

ease.description: How the outline travels to the next key.

shape_morph.description: Morph an existing path shape: replaces its point animation with these outlines over time; its outline becomes the first key's. Outlines may differ in points and contours; they are matched automatically.

shape_width.description: Shape width as a fraction of the canvas height.

shape_height.description: Shape height as a fraction of the canvas height.

block_id.description: The block (option.blocks[].block_id) this operation was compiled from.

role.description: The block's role for this operation, e.g. hold, exit, enter, empty_set.

index.description: Which instance of that role, from 0.

block_ref.description: Set by the server: the block (option.blocks) and role this operation was compiled from. Do not send it.

operations.description: The changes, applied in order. With operations_from, the compiled operations come first and these follow.

compile_id.description: A compile_id returned by a compile tool such as caption_proposal_compile, for this card's expected_revision.

operations_from.description: Use a compile tool's stored operations instead of pasting them: they are placed first, in this order, and their review_controls are used when the option sends none.

block_id.description: Names this block on the card and in overrides; element ids derive from it, so use a different id for each pending card.

kind.description: A registered block kind: live_hold, keyframed_move, hop_sequence (or operations, whose inputs.operations are plain operations).

version.description: The block version this card was drafted with.

inputs.description: Measured inputs the block compiles from (sources, cut-out receipts, subject boxes, settle and takeoff frames). Never detectors: compiling runs no model.

settings.description: Setting values to depart from the defaults; omit a setting to take its default. A per-instance setting (one per stop or hop) is an array in instance order.

seed.description: Set by the server from the card's revision: element ids derive from it. Do not send it.

frame_rate.description: Set by the server: the project frame grid the block compiles on. Do not send it.

blocks.description: Building blocks (see proposal-building-blocks): each is a registered kind with measured inputs and typed settings. The server compiles them to operations after `operations`, on every preview, dial move and approval, and their settings are the card's dials (no review_controls needed). Send settings only to depart from the defaults.
